value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim Preschool A, Saturdays 9:00-9:30, and Preschool B, 9:40-10:10, both Sept 12 to Nov 28 for ages 3-5 - their site says. Resident registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am; I could not pin down the price, and I'll keep watching and text you when I find it.
